gloss: to be overcome with emotion; to have a full heart

definitions.gloss: to be overcome with emotion; to be too moved to speak
definitions.explanation: Being so filled with joy, gratitude, sadness, or nostalgia that one can hardly speak; literally 'the chest is full.' The emotion is marked with で: {感謝|かんしゃ}の{気持|きも}ちで{胸|むね}がいっぱいです, a fixture of speeches and thank-you messages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胸|むね}がいっぱいです。
examples.english: My heart is full of gratitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧とき、{胸|むね}がいっぱいになった。
examples.english: Saying goodbye to my friends at graduation, I was overcome with emotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、{懐|なつ}かしさ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胸|むね}がいっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing the scenery of my hometown for the first time in years, I was so full of nostalgia that I couldn't speak.

notes:
Literally 'the chest is full', leaving no room for words. Usually 〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胸|むね}がいっぱい, with the emotion marked by ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胸|むね}がいっぱい: full of gratitude
- {胸|むね}がいっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be overcome with emotion
- {胸|むね}がいっぱい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べられない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: too full of emotion to eat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{感動|かんどう}する→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧: to be moved — the plain verb
- ⟦{胸|むね}が{熱|あつ}くなる→胸が熱くなる：20455_munegaatsukunaru⟧: to feel a surge of emotion — a sudden warmth rather than fullness
- ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱい: to be full (of food) — the literal fullness is in the belly, not the chest
